note: TestRFC7440ClientWindowsize: OACK windowsize 0 must draw ERROR with code exactly 8, silence and a failed fetch (red if the lower-range check in grantWindowsize is removed: 0 would be acked). windowsize 2 is accepted with ACK 0. The 65536 case is refused by the not-above-request check, not the range check, so it isolates nothing; the upper bound cannot be exceeded because the client requests 4 and refuses anything above it. Refusing an in-range value is allowed by 3-4, so the only violation is using an out-of-range value, which the 0 case catches.
